verdict.rationale: The ingestion docs say ClickHouse's s3() and url() table functions 'work as documented' on ObsessionDB. That implies files in object storage can be read through SQL table functions, but the docs frame it only as an ingestion path and never mention querying in place. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of Iceberg, Delta Lake or Parquet support; documentation of querying external files in place rather than loading them into MergeTree; lakehouse catalog integration; independent or hands-on corroboration.
